newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes flat ahead of rate rise.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes flat ahead of rate rise.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 1,950-1,980 per dollar, flat from opening at 1,950-1,980 after a range bound interbank trade as dollar supply increased ahead of main lev rate rise, dealers said.
"Trade was very calm and range-bound throughout the day. Some large final clients were bidding for small dollar volumes but supply was big enough to meet demand," one dealer said.
Dollar supply rose after the central bank said on Thursday it would raise its central interest rate tomorrow.

"Banks were more willing to pare forex positions today in favour of lev-denominated investments because of the new rate, which promises higher yield amid the recent lev stability", another trader said.
The lev has traded between 2,000-2,300 until Friday.

The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said on Thursday it would raise its central interest rate (CIR) to 18 percent monthly from 16.5 percent from March 1 because of rising yield of government securities at recent BNB T-bill auctions.
